data.name: Josephson junction
data.function: Aluminium/aluminium-oxide/aluminium tunnel junction of about 100×100 nm² forming the non-linear inductor of the transmon. Its critical current sets E_J; because the qubit frequency goes as √(8E_J E_C), a 1 % spread in junction resistance across a wafer becomes a 0.5 % (25 MHz) spread in frequency, which is why frequency plans need collision checks.

physics.summary: Non-linear inductance; E_J from the critical current.

data.tooltip: Josephson junction: the transmon's non-linear inductor.
